assumptions: Independent cases; correctly specified conditional mean/link; no unmeasured confounding is established by this fit.

plots.note: Conditional fitted means, not individual prediction intervals or total pathway effects. Other numerical predictors are held at complete-case means and categorical predictors at their declared reference.
